More importantly, the message drops the second slot's critical details—Kinderfun's full schedule (Saturdays 10:30-11:15, Sept 13-Oct 25, $145) is mentioned only in passing without dates or price. The watchFor guidance emphasizes that the registration date must be carried to the parent, which the message does, but the phrasing "filling up" borders on claiming partial verification rather than purely reporting what the page says. The message also lacks a clear closing question and is somewhat conversational rather than the prescribed "one or two short plain-ASCII sentences." The slots themselves are excellent (5-worthy) but the message undershoots the standard by omitting full details of the second program and softening the registration window language slightly.
